faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Countersunk Screw (ISO 10642) suitable for Countersunk flat head screw for flush mounting?
faq.a: Titanium Countersunk Screw (ISO 10642) uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address fastener operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Countersunk Screw (ISO 10642)?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Countersunk Screw (ISO 10642) require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. fastener components receive Passivation per ASTM B600 followed by hot DI water rinse 70C minimum to prevent flash rust on finished surfaces. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Countersunk Screw (ISO 10642) shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.
